purpose_context: The observability layer reports data-plane counts but not component liveness. A recent live experiment could only discover a paused watcher and an unreachable component by manual curl probing. This mission adds a component-health board (UP/DOWN/DEGRADED per component) via a new 'goldberg doctor' command and a compact section in 'goldberg status'.
purpose_tldr: Show operators at a glance whether every pipeline component is online, so outages are visible without hand-probing.
